profile.headline: Founder | Head of Product | Lumi Creator Benefit Corporation
profile.summary:
Product-focused systems engineer designing scalable platforms for complex financial and
collaboration workflows. Designs event-driven systems, modular domain architectures, and
distributed platforms while translating business requirements into high-leverage technical
systems.

positions.title: Founder, CEO & Head of Product
positions.description:
• Founded Lumi, a Benefit Corporation focused on creator collaboration, overseeing all aspects of company formation and operations.  
• Developed the core product concept and conducted market research to validate the platform's potential.  
• Designed and built the iOS app and web platform, managing end-to-end development including backend architecture.

positions.title: Lead Senior Software Engineer (Technical Product Lead)
positions.description:
Lead engineer driving architecture and product design across legacy modernization and the
SyncPoint distributed platform, a multi-tenant financial workflow system supporting federal
program operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Led the development of financial workflow APIs and domain models for budgeting, approvals, and reporting systems.  
• Achieved a ~35% reduction in application load times through frontend optimization and improved backend query patterns.  
• Refactored legacy architecture into modular components, enhancing maintainability and development velocity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed APIs and UI components for financial planning and budgeting systems utilized by government program offices.  
• Implemented workflow automation and approval pipelines to enhance operational efficiency.  
• Collaborated with stakeholders to translate business processes into scalable product features.  
• Contributed to Pioneering Evolution, LLC's mission of delivering innovative solutions in the financial sector.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked as a lead developer on a java enterprise web application. The application was built with a spring-boot backend and an Angular frontend.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a feature for a web application that utilized various API endpoints to tailor responses and perform calculations according to requirements set by company technicians.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
• Supervised and counseled 51 resident students on academic, personal, and social matters, fostering a supportive environment.  
• Developed and implemented programs to promote inclusivity and community engagement among residents.  
• Monitored residential halls during night shifts and participated in a rotational work schedule, ensuring safety and support.  
• Collaborated closely with a Resident Director, attending weekly staff meetings and bi-weekly one-on-one sessions for professional growth.
